highlights.title: Statistics count with many models offered
highlights.detail: If your Darkbloom provider offers several models, statistics used to pause until every one of them was loaded, which rarely happens because Darkbloom loads models as requests arrive. They now count for the models loaded right now and start a fresh measurement whenever one loads or unloads, so numbers from different sets never mix.

highlights.title: Clearer multi-model notice
highlights.detail: The notice names any models that aren't loaded and any your Mac offers that Darkbloom's catalog no longer lists (those get no work; darkbloom models remove clears them). Models Bloomkeeper can use now shows every model your Mac offers, including ones outside the catalog, dimmed.

highlights.title: Problem reports you can still send
highlights.detail: If an automatic report is held back or fails, the report prompt stays so you can send it yourself, and a failed automatic send no longer uses up the daily limit.
